title: Radiant Nuclear media slot
description: A square-cornered frame for a photo, video or illustration that fills it like object-fit: cover. Empty, it is a plain placeholder surface: deeper cream, a pale teal-to-cream wash, or a charcoal 'night' gradient for slots that carry white type. Can lay the original's black-to-clear photo gradient on top.
notes: size and position come from className; a passed img or video is stretched to cover the frame
`shade` adds the bottom-up darkening used under hero and video type
the night tone and the shades stay dark in dark mode (they switch to the background colour)
name: radiantnuclear-slot

props.name: media
props.description: the real image or video; leave empty for the placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder colour: deeper cream, a pale teal wash, or a dark 'night' gradient (for slots under white type)

props.name: shade
props.description: lay a bottom-up darkening over the media, for type set on top of it
